articleTitle: Review on Charging Methods and Electric Drive Solutions for Electric Vehicles in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-In India, the regulations pertaining to electric vehicles (EVs) and their charging have mainly been influenced by global standards. In comparison to other nations with the second largest population and the seventh largest country, the low rate of EV adoption is significant; it will take time to catch up with the growth rate. Therefore, in order to encourage the sale and use of EVs in India, it is imperative to develop a strong and appropriate charging infrastructure and driving technologies. Electric Vehicles (EVs) are gaining popularity in India due to low maintenance cost and zero emissions. The range of the EVs depends on the energy stored in their batteries which can be charged by using a normal (AC) charger or a fast (DC) charger. The batteries in EVs can be used as storage devices in Vehicle to Vehicle (V2V) and Vehicle to Load (V2L) technologies. Electric Drives plays an important role in EV applications. Hence this paper comprehensively investigates the state of the art of EV charging methods and electric drive solutions for EV applications in India.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Buck-Boost, SEPIC and Zeta Converters for Active Cell Balancing in EV Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Improved optimization of the battery pack’s total capacity is made possible by using balancing cells. This mechanism guarantees that each cell within the battery is protected from excessive charging or discharging, hence optimizing the battery’s energy utilization and mitigating the risk of premature degradation in certain cells. Active cell balancing is a technique employed to uphold secure operational circumstances, hence mitigating the likelihood of cell degradation and associated fire-related perils. Converters play a crucial role in active cell balancing because they can actively control voltages, facilitate energy transfer, and seamlessly connect with the battery management system (BMS), enabling optimum and balanced cell performance. The performance of three well-known DC-DC converter topologies-Buck-Boost, Single-Ended Primary Inverter Converter (SEPIC), and Zeta converters-is examined academically in this article. These converters are utilized for active cell balancing in electric vehicles. The objective is to evaluate the efficiency, efficacy in maintaining cell voltage equilibrium, and suitability for improving the overall performance of battery systems in electric vehicles

articleTitle: Novel Approach for the Extraction of Keywords from Text Document
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-In the present computing scenario, ${8 5 \%}$ of the data we generate every day is unstructured. Analyzing unstructured data from various sources to extract the most important information is extremely difficult. Furthermore, processing the same unstructured input data will take more time and be prone to errors. A method is proposed to restructure the given input to avoid problems when analyzing unstructured data. After restructuring, the following phase, keyword extraction, becomes crucial for modeling the system’s requirements. Therefore, the proposed method is to develop an automated system for extracting keywords from text to achieve effective outcomes in terms of time, effort, desired output, and high accuracy. This paper proposes an approach based on parts of speech tagging to extract important parts from the document content. In particular, the keyword extraction technique tags the document contents and extracts keywords by considering the main parts of speech. It further identifies referenced nouns and defined verbs, along with the main parts of speech, to address the dependency between extracted keywords. After keyword extraction, the JSON format is used to organize structured data. The research results on various texts demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has higher precision, recall, and F value than conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: A Critical Review on Charging Infrastructure and Standards Intended for Wireless Charging of EVs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Wireless charging is a method of recharging electrical devices by sending electricity across an air gap created between the transmitter pad and receiver pad. Commercial wireless charging methods and solutions have emerged, providing a workable answer to the energy crunch experienced by most battery-powered devices. Modern technology that allows for simplicity, flexibility, and the potential for fully automated charging is wireless power transfer. The advantages of wireless power transfer (WPT) over wired counterparts, including the lack of exposed connections, ease of charging, and fearless power delivery in challenging circumstances, make them enticing. The WPT system is created by first analyzing the parameters of each component and calculating how those parameters affect the system’s performance. Instead of concentrating on the development of WPT technology, this paper covers the charging infrastructure and standards designed for wireless charging of light-duty electric vehicles, passenger vehicles, and heavy-duty vehicles. Also, the need for electromagnetic shielding and its impact on the system’s performance and methods are detailed here. Further, investigations on various coil structures are performed and their specifications, features and factors are detailed.

articleTitle: A Survey On Twitter Spam Drift Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Twitter has made it easier for users to find information by enabling them to express their ideas and opinions in regular tweets. Unfortunately, because Twitter is so popular, spammers have found it useful for disseminating their junk. In contrast to other forms of spam, Twitter spam has escalated over the past few years. The sheer number of users on Twitter and the amount of content that is posted there are the main causes of the spread of spam. Twitter and the academic community have been working on a number of spam detection systems using different machine-learning algorithms in order to safeguard users. However, a recent study discovered that the machine learning-based detection algorithms now in use are unable to effectively identify spam since the characteristics of spam tweets change over time.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Placement and Sizing of multiple DGs and DSTATCOMs in Unbalanced Distribution Network using CPSOS Approach.
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: This paper introduces a Multi-Objective Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization with Sigmoid-based (MO-CPSOS) acceleration coefficient approach for optimal placement and sizing of Distributed Generators (DG) and DSTATCOMs in an unbalanced radial distribution network. The MO-CPSOS approach utilizes a logistic map to generate well-distributed initial particles efficiently and employs sigmoid-based acceleration coefficients to balance global search and convergence. By integrating exploration and exploitation, this approach enhances both global and local search capabilities of the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. The study formulates the optimization problem as a multi-objective function, targeting the reduction of total real power loss, enhancement of voltage balance, and improvement of the voltage profile through optimal placement and sizing of DG and DSTATCOM devices. Computational efficiency and performance of the MO-CPSOS approach are conducted, comparing its efficacy against the standard PSO method across various test cases. The validity of the proposed approach is demonstrated through simulations conducted on the IEEE 37 - bus test systems.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Frameworks for the Classification of Brain Tumors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Brain Tumor Detection from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a crucial task for many applications in the Analysis of Medical field. Nowadays, the classification of brain tumors is of crucial importance for the early detection and therapy planning of patients. Deep learning approaches have made amazing advances in a variety of medical image processing applications, including brain tumors classification, in recent years. This work gives a thorough investigation into the usage of deep learning approaches for accurate and efficient classification of brain tumors, making use of medical imaging data. Our model was developed using a large dataset of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) images gathered from various sources. Initially, Segmentation includes preprocessing of MRI Images using different modalities such as an isotropic Filtering, Feature extraction with discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and principal component analysis (PCA) algorithm. Finally, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transfer learning algorithms are used to build a novel deep neural network architecture suited for brain tumors classification. The proposed system objects to identify whether the given MRI scan indications a tumor and it found, classifies the tumor as malignant or benign. The proposed classifier gives an outstanding performance than various existing classifiers such as OTSU-DWT-PCA-SVM, Canny-DWT-PCA-SVM, Canny-CNN, and OTSU-CNN classifiers in terms of accuracy in brain tumor classification.

articleTitle: Utilization of copper slag in developing slag-based Ultra-High-Performance Concrete
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: The incorporation of copper slag in geopolymer concrete will improve its mechanical properties. This study aims to research the influence of copper slag on making Ultra-High Performance concrete. The increase in copper slag made the concrete denser and more integral. The utilization of fine copper slag as aggregate and GGBS as a binder improves the compressive strength. Various curing regimes were experimented with, out of which the ambient-cured specimen showed better performance than steam curing, heat curing, conventional water curing, and boiling water curing methods. With the replacement of copper slag, the specimens’ water absorption and porosity decreased by as much as $\mathbf{4 0 \%}$. The porosity of the composites increases as copper slag content rises, increasing moisture infiltration. In developing the affordable and sustainable UHPC mix, the incorporation of copper slag as aggregate and utilizing GGBS as binder gave promising results. This initial study, by accessing the compressive strength of the slag-based UHPGC, would shed some light on manufacturing industry-ready high-performance concrete using industrial by products.

articleTitle: Audio Feedback Through Realtime Object Detection Using Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-This study offers a novel approach that combines Google Text-to-Speech (GTTS) with YOLOv5 (You Only Look One) object identification to improve accessibility for those with visual impairments. By using object detection and sound recognition to provide real-time information about their surroundings, the suggested system empowers blind individuals. Leveraging its efficiency and speed, the YOLOv5 model is used to reliably identify and categorize items inside the user’s surroundings. To improve situational awareness, sound recognition algorithms are integrated in tandem to recognize and analyse auditory signals, such as alerts, sirens, or other significant noises. Detected items are translated into intelligible spoken descriptions using GTTS to fill in the visual information gap and provide an aural comprehension of the environment. The realtime operation of the system guarantees the prompt and pertinent dissemination of information. Extensive testing with visually impaired participants is used to assess the efficacy of the proposed solution, with a focus on user input and system response. The results show how the system can greatly enhance the quality of life for those who are visually impaired by providing them with a thorough and intuitive grasp of their surroundings.

articleTitle: Gain Enhancement of Circularly Polarized MIMO Antenna for WLAN/ZigBee/Bluetooth Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: A dual-band MIMO antenna with gain enhancement is intended for Bluetooth, wireless local-area network (WLAN), Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX), and ZigBee applications. Along with increased gain, the suggested MIMO antenna generates circular polarization at 2.33 GHz and 2.44 GHz. The circular polarization offers improved and uniform coverage. The proposed antenna has dual-band response at 2.33 GHz and 2.44 GHz with reference to the return loss S 11 < -10 dB and gain of 8.07 dBi, 8.27 dBi and efficiency of 86.44%, 76.30% at 2.33 GHz and 2.44 GHz respectively. It has an average gain (dBi) of 8.17 dBi. Moreover, the proposed MIMO antenna has improved gain according to the recent requirements of wireless communications. The proposed MIMO antenna consists of double split ring slots with coaxial feeding. The radiating slot consists of both circular and rectangular double split slots. Therefore, it is easy to tune the dual-band operation by adjusting the slot lengths. Moreover, the bottom ground plane reduces the back radiation.

articleTitle: An Improved Electrocardiogram Classification Using Pre Trained Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: In this article, we present a deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) transfer learning strategy to classify the ECG signals. The proposed pre trained network uses a combined Imagenet with very large tagged image datasets and a separate network made up of fully connected layers. In this approach, first apply discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to generate time-frequency representation of ECG signals and convert them into RGB images. Then the resulting images are given to the pre trained CNN to obtain the features. We then use supervised learning to train the neural network on the ECG labeled data using CNN features. To train a Deep Neura Network three sets of PhysioNet databases such as MIT-BIH (ARR) Arrhythmia, NSR (Normal Sinus Rhythm), and BIDMC CHF (Congestive Heart Failure) databases are considered and compare the classification accuracy of DWT with both Alexnet and Googlenet pre trained networks.

articleTitle: Low-Power Ternary Multiplication Using Approximate Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: This study is being conducted with the intention of presenting a novel approximate computation technique that is capable of performing ternary multiplication while consuming a minimal amount of electricity. The low-power design methodology that utilizes carbon nanotube field-effect transistors (FETs) is utilized in order to propose a carry-truncated ternary multiplier, error compensation circuits, and 2 ×2 ternary multipliers with varying degrees of precision. This methodology is employed for the goal of suggesting a carry-truncated ternary multiplier. A approach that allows for the customization of the precision of the design is recommended for the design of energy-efficient 6 ×6 approximation ternary multipliers. This advice is offered in the context of the design process. Through the usage of HSPICE simulation, it has been verified that the energy benefits of the suggested 6 × 6 approximation ternary multipliers have been proven within the realm of energy benefits. When compared to the previous approximate multiplier-based design, the proposed approximate design demonstrates an improvement of 41.8% in mean absolute percentage error and 82.8% in power-delay product. Both of these improvements are significant. Both of these improvements are significant. In order to verify that the user’s need for the accuracy of ternary multiplication is met, image processing applications are carried out with the help of the provided approximation designs.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of a Bandgap Voltage Reference Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: The design and optimization of a Bandgap reference circuit, a critical component in the area of Analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits This research presents a comprehensive study on the design. Bandgap voltage references are essential for providing stable and temperature-independent voltage references, crucial for ensuring accurate and reliable operation of various electronic systems. The proposed design employs a combination of hybrid bipolar and Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) transistor technologies in order to provide a stable and temperature–compensated output voltage. The study investigates several circuit topologies and evaluates their performance using metrics like line regulation and temperature coefficient. The outcomes of the simulation demonstrate that the suggested structure works to achieve a low temperature coefficient. The optimized bandgap reference exhibits superior performance compared to existing designs, making it well-suited for applications demanding high precision and reliability, such as voltage regulators, analog-to-digital converters, and sensor interfaces.

articleTitle: GSE and GWE Techniques to improve ON (IoN) current and Ambipolar conduction of Tunnel FET(TFET) device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-Metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (MOSFET) devices are in high demand due to their adaptability. These MOS transistors scale down to make next generation technology for high speed and low power. However, shot channel effects and the minimal subthreshold swing (SS>60 mV/Dec) restrict MOSFET growth. Tunnel FETs (TFETs) are a promising alternative to MOSFETs owing to their improved subthreshold properties (SS<60 mV/Dec) and band-to-band tunnelling (BTBT) charge carrier transfer. The SCE is eliminated by the TFET technology, allowing industry-required precise scaling. Low ON(ION) current and ambipolar conduction make TFET performance chaotic. Thus, researcher suggested gate structural engineering (GSE) and gate work function engineering (GWE) as the best ways to solve these issues and improve TFET. This work performs the analytica analysis on different devices reported on these two approaches using TFET specifications. A comprehensive examination shows how these strategies increase the device’s on (Ion) current and reduce its ambipolar current.

articleTitle: DC Microgrid Technology: Study on DC Microgrid Bus Configurations and Architectures for Rural Electrification and a Proposed DC Microgrid Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-The country’s growing population puts additional pressure on power grids for electricity. The integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DER) has emerged as a viable approach to address issues related to energy scarcity, power reliability, and electricity price volatility. Since the mid-2000s, integration of DERs with the grid has become an important area of research. In particular, the high cost of infrastructure and insufficient power generation make it impossible to electrify rural areas using national power grids. Due to its benefits and flexibility, low voltage, low power solar PV DC microgrids have received a lot of interest in recent years. Because of their efficient distribution, these DC microgrids are increasingly being installed in rural locations. Therefore, it is becoming essential to plan appropriate architectures for rural electrification based on load alignment and location. This paper provides a detailed examination of the many DC Microgri distribution topologies that have been published in the literature. A suitable architecture was suggested based on a comparison of several designs to provide more reliable and minimal line loss electricity to those living in rural areas. The researchers can select or create suitable DC Microgrid architecture and control strategies to deliver higher power standards thanks to this comparison investigation.

articleTitle: Securing Smart Cities: AI-Driven Video Injection Attack Detection for Enhanced Urban Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: With the integration of video surveillance sensors into smart city applications, video content security becomes more important. This research uses a combination of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks to provide a detailed framework to detect video injection attacks. The method is evaluated using the Kitsune Network Attack Dataset, which includes a variety of network traffic scenarios for an in-depth examination. The proposed model achieves excellent outcomes with an accuracy of $98.0 \%$, precision of $99.8 \%$, recall of $99.7 \%$, and F1-score of $99.6 \%$. Moreover, extensive examination using a confusion matrix and metrics such as False Discovery Rate (FDR), False Negative Rate (FNR), False Omission Rate (FOR), and False Positive Rate (FPR) illustrate the model’s reliability in identifying between genuine and injected video and audio frames. The successful implementation of the proposed video injection attack detection technique has been demonstrated in this paper, which is facilitating the improvement of smart city security. The results of this research paper provide significant perspectives for implementing forefront safety procedures and preserving the reliability and integrity of video frames in the context of smart cities.

articleTitle: Recognition of Ancient Tamil Brahmi Symbols and Notations Using ELM-ISMO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Digitalizing ancient images, symbols and notations from stone inscriptions which reveals the cultural history is a way to preserve and emphasize our country’s heritage. This paper discusses, symbols from ancient Tamil Brahmi scripts are recognized using Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) with Improved Spider Monkey Optimization (ISMO) algorithm. Initially, the input images are preprocessed using Histogram Equalization (HE) method followed by segmentation using KMeans clustering algorithm. Then, the segmented characters are recognized and classified into equivalent Tamil characters using ELM-ISMO algorithm. The performance results of ELM-ISMO algorithm is compared with ELM, CNN and ANN algorithms. The performance metrics sensitivity, specificity, accuracy and F1-Score are measured. Performance results have shown that the proposed ELM-ISMO outperforms the existing algorithms in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and F1-score metrics.

articleTitle: Design Of Wearable Patch Antenna Using Wireless Body Area Networks - Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Antennas are essential in wireless communication, serving as a link between digital devices and the vast networks that run our modern life. They are particularly crucial in wide area networks (WANs), which span large geographic areas. Antennas are designed to broadcast and receive signals across great distances while maintaining flawless connectivity. Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) have emerged as transformative technology in various applications, such as healthcare monitoring and sports performance analysis. The proposed idea focuses on designing and optimizing a wearable antenna specifically for WBANs, addressing the unique challenges of on-body communication. The system offers reliable wireless connectivity while considering size constraints, power efficiency and regulatory compliance. Key objectives include selecting the appropriate frequency band, choosing the right antenna type, optimizing antenna placement for user comfort and achieving precise impedance matching for efficient data transmission. The proposed idea uses electromagnetic simulation tools for design and construction of physical prototypes for real-world testing.

articleTitle: Design of Novel Cross-Tied Trinary Sequence Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Multilevel Inverters (MLIs) are gaining attention in the field of high-power medium voltage applications. The compact design of MLIs results in development of various new topologies. In this article, a novel Cross-Tied MLI topology is proposed. The basic unit with trinary sequence selection of DC sources generates 9-levels with twelve switches and two DC voltage sources. However, the extended version of the basic unit with n-modules generate $3^{n+1}$ levels using $7 n+5$ switches and $n+1$ DC voltage sources. The procedures for the selection of voltage sources for the proposed inverter is elaborated. Basic unit and extended version of the proposed MLI are simulated in MATLAB/Simulink platform with Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM) technique and analyzed them with various recent topologies. From the results, it is analyzed that the proposed inverter gives better performance compared to recent topologies. Also, the harmonics at the output side are maintained according to IEEE standards.

articleTitle: Return Loss Prediction of Square Patch Antenna with Defective Ground Structure for RF Energy Harvesting in Smart Cities using ANN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: In this paper, a predictive approach for calculating the return loss of a slotted square patch antenna with a defective ground structure (SSPA-DGS) designed for energy-harvesting applications in smart cities is introduced. The strategy makes use of the Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). The Proposed antenna works from the frequency range of 1.7 GHz to 3.2 GHz. We varied the antenna internal slot radius Ra, patch length la, thickness t, and dielectric constant of the antenna. From the total 125 data samples were taken from the simulation using HFSS software, and all the samples were used in ML models. For validation, 25 data samples are used to test the prepared models for the ANN. The data is compared with the simulated return loss data. The predicted return loss of ANN model has an error of 0.016095848.

Author Keywords: Slotted Square Patch Antenna with Defected Ground Structure (SSPA-DGS)

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Approximate Compressors for Balanced Error Accumulation in MAC Operator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: This paper introduces a new approach to approximate computing that can be used to implement multiplyaccumulate (MAC) processing with little energy consumption. Rather than letting the error accumulation restrict the approximation range, our method uses a combination of interleaved approximate multipliers to reduce the impact of errors introduced by the opposite direction during accumulate operations. This varies from previous studies. To accomplish balanced error accumulation, we first reduce processing costs by making approximation 4-2 compressors that generate mistakes in the opposite direction. To achieve a similar error distance, identical positive and negative multipliers are meticulously created after the probability analysis. The suggested MAC processing provides an energy-efficient computing scenario by increasing the number of approximation sections, as shown by simulation results of multiple real-world applications. For instance, the present CNN accelerator achieves the same level of identification accuracy while reducing core-level energy consumption by about $35 \%$ using the interleaving method compared to state-of-the-art alternatives.

articleTitle: Assessment of Sustainability of Proposed East Bypass Road of Vijayawada using Rapid Impact Assessment Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: For every type of large scale project, to protect the sustainability of the environment, an assessment of the effects on the environment is required. Three bypass route solutions have been presented by the Indian National Highway Authority and State Government for Vijayawada city to solve the traffic congestion problem. This project entails purchasing land in order to construct a road that will affect woods, water bodies, agricultural land, and other locations. This paper’s main objective is to ascertain how the proposed East Bypass Road would affect Vijayawada, an Andhra Pradesh city, and to deduce the results in such a way that will enable wise decisionmaking. All potential effects that have been discovered are sent to the Rapid Impact Assessment Matrix (RIAM), which processes them for assessment. The RIAM uses various parameters in the four categories: PC(Physico-Chemical), BE (Biological-Ecological), SC(Social-Cultural), and EO (Economical-Operational) to determine the impacts. The RIAM analysis states that the Bypass Road project has both positive and negative consequences in all three possibilities across all locations. Bar charts were used to display the results of the comparison between these three options. The findings are very helpful in making better decisions. Titles in RIAM software are first displayed as Options-1, Option-2, and Option-3. Option 1 travels 74 km from Kotturu to Pottipadu, Option 2 travels 44 km from Kaza to Chinavutapalli, and Option 3 travels 40 km from Kaza to Chinavutapalli. The effects on the list are recognized and assigned values. The results of alternatives (1), (2), and (3) are compared in terms of their environmental score. When choices were compared for sustainability, Option 3 was determined to have the least negative effects.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effect of Contrast Enhancement Techniques on Chest X-Ray Classification Using Deep Learners
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-The accurate classification of medical images using deep learning techniques can significantly aid doctors in their medical diagnosis. However, medical datasets often have limited data and low image quality, affecting the detection of pathological conditions. This study evaluates deep learning models - Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and pretrained transfer learner VGG-16, to classify chest X-ray images for tuberculosis detection. We also evaluate the impact of different contrast enhancement techniques: Histogram Equalization (HE), gamma correction, and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Our results demonstrate that the pre-trained VGG-16 model outperforms CNN trained on the dataset. The choice of preprocessing method varies depending on the classification model. While gamma correction improves the classification performance of CNN VGG-16 works well with CLAHE. On the other hand, HE fails to provide any improvement. The finding highlights the importance of optimal preprocessing and transfer learning in overcoming dataset limitations and enhancing diagnostic capabilities in medical imaging.

articleTitle: Chromatic Logical Fusion for Road Feature Extraction in VHR-RGB Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Road extraction from very high-resolution (VHR) true color (RGB) images is a popular task in the area of image processing and computer vision. However, there are a number of obstacles that make this task difficult, such as road coverage by tree canopies, shadows, and similar surface objects. To fine-tune the task of road feature extraction, we have proposed a hybrid approach involving various popular image processing functions such as thresholding, fusion, and morphology. Moreover, road extraction from satellite-based VHR-RGB images is quite challenging as compared to doing the same task using multispectral or hyperspectral images. After road extraction, we have also analyzed the efficacy of our proposed approach using several machine learning algorithms. Ultimately, a higher performance with 91.52% accuracy was achieved for the task using the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Power Enhancement of Renewable Energy-Based Generation System Using UPQC
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: In order to achieve economic, clean energy, and resilience goals, renewable energy resources must be integrated into power systems. However, issues arise because of renewable instability and uncertainty, as well as a lack of intrinsic system inertia. integration of renewable energy sources. Unified power quality conditioners (UPQC) provide promising power quality solutions. To solve voltage fluctuations and consumer-related power concerns, UPQC combines Active Power Filters (APF) and Shunt-APF series. UPQC ensures stable voltage profiles, efficient power generation, and dependable distribution with two IGBTbased voltage source converters (VSCs). This review study emphasizes UPQC’s versatility, which makes it an essential tool for modern power systems that incorporate renewable energy sources. Grid-connected solar and wind power systems connected to variable loads are the focus of this analysis. Fuzzy Logic Controller based PV-WE system which improves efficiency analyzed in this paper. The grid-related PV-WE device’s electricity quality needs to be improved because it hasn’t yet been put through testing and created using methods for improving electricity quality. The PV-WE system can achieve the benefit from robust power delivery, potent load demand for reaction, and effective energy utilization. UPQC is used in the advised look at that addresses this subject.

articleTitle: Study on the Webpage properties and prediction using Google.
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Use of a search engine became sustenance for knowledge and information. Today the user depends on a few search engines as they deliver most favourable results. People browse few top cited link information, from 20 to 30 links delivered and opt out in case they are not able to get the relevant information. A search engine gets a few query terms as input, does computations and retrieves thousands of web pages. To manage this mega result link set, every search engine uses some ranking criterion. PageRank is one of the most popularly ranking algorithms used in Google and applied beyond its original scope and implemented in ranking several domains. With the ever growing amount of information and usage of computers, internet is rapidly expanding; and hence the results need not be the same with time. The link structure is a basis of such computation and this process motivates to understand the properties of web pages. Web page properties of these resulted set are studied earlier but detailed work was not carried for forecasting a web page and its probable rank using PageRank/Google. We developed a new method and results in contemplating the rank of the web page popped in top 30 web page links.

articleTitle: DeepRiceTransfer: Exploiting CNN Transfer Learning for Effective Rice Variety Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract- The proposed DeepRiceTransfer (DRT) model gives a thorough examination of the accurate categorization of rice types. The research aimed at reworking the accuracy and effectiveness of rice variety types. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and transfer learning are utilized by the version to strategically capitalize on previous facts from several datasets. The proposed methodology used many extraordinary neural network architectures, along with the DeepRiceTransfer Convolutional Neural community (CNN) for the rice image dataset, to achieve the correct type of results. To enhance the model’s overall performance, we especially used transfer learning methods with the MobileNet, ResNet50, and VGG16 architectures. Numerous statistical criteria, which include accuracy, precision, F1 score, and support, have been used to evaluate the class consequences. With accuracy scores of 98.44% for the DRT model,98.94% for CNN with transfer learning using MobileNet, 79.79% for ResNet50, and 99.47% for VGG16 architectures, the models showed impressive success in classifying rice varieties. The models confirmed impressive achievement in classifying rice types effects spotlight CNN models’ effectiveness in efficaciously classifying rice sorts consistent with their distinctive trends, especially those who use DRT and switch getting to know with MobileNet, ResNet50, and VGG16 architectures. The models’ elevated accuracy charges spotlight their capacity for real-time implementations in the rice range category and first-class assessment.

articleTitle: Advanced Energy Management through FLC-Optimized Electric Vehicle Hybrid Storage employing Batteries and Super capacitors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: This electronic This paper describes a cutting-edge energy management approach for electric vehicles (EVs) that use a hybrid storage system (HSS) that includes both batteries and super capacitors. The major goal is to optimize energy utilization, improve battery cycle longevity, and address the various issues. The proposed methods employ an advanced energy management strategy that effortlessly integrates a fuzzy logic controller (FLC) into the EV’s HSS. In order to reduce the total size of the energy storage system (ESS) and increase the battery’s operational life, the research will combine batteries and super capacitors. In order to verify the effectiveness of the suggested methodology, an exhaustive evaluation was carried out utilizing the MATLAB/ Simulink software. This entailed evaluating the super capacitor’s state of charge as well as the battery’s power dynamics throughout a variety of driving conditions and time periods. The deployment of a unique FLC technique, painstakingly managing energy and power transfer between the battery and super capacitor, is the study’s highlight feature. In comparison to conventional control methodologies, the FLC-enhanced hybrid storage system demonstrated superior outcomes, showcasing its potential as a futuristic energy management solution for electric vehicles. The findings suggest that this approach holds promise for optimizing energy efficiency, reducing the environmental impact, and advancing the viability of electric vehicles in the future.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Control for UPQC using ANN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: UPQC, Unified Power Quality Conditioner is multifunctional device in FACTS family which can provide independent or combined functions of shunt compensator, series compensator, voltage regulator and phase angle regulator. UPQC can compensate not only harmonic currents and unbalances of a non-linear load but also voltage harmonics and unbalances of the power supply which improves the power quality offered for other harmonic sensitive loads. The proposed work is to develop a power quality conditioner with a simple and robust controller to compensate for the voltage sag, voltage unbalance, harmonics, sag with unbalance, unbalance with harmonics. In traditional proportional-integral (PI) or proportional-integral derivative (PID) feedback controllers, careful tuning is required and the residual tracking error due to hysteresis and dynamic effects persists from one cycle to the next. The proposed controller will drive the tracking error asymptotically to zero as the number of operating cycles increases. Since control circuit relies on the availability and quality of sensor measurement, a circuit development for detecting faulty sensors and to restore the missing sensors using ANN and PSO is also proposed. The proposed work is to develop an ANN based fault tolerant control system for controlling of UPQC connected to a 440 V radial distribution network.

articleTitle: Robust Deep Learning Models For Wildlife Detection: Adapting To Varying Environmental Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-Wildlife conservation and the effective mitigation of human-wildlife conflicts heavily rely on the dependable detection and continuous monitoring of wildlife across a wide spectrum of ever-changing environments. In this study, we investigate the versatility of two deep learning models, RetinaNet-152 and DenseNet-201, in tackling the complexities presented by fluctuating environmental conditions in wildlife detection. RetinaNet-152, renowned for its depth and skip connections, is adept at capturing intricate features in images, making it an excellent candidate for scenarios with diverse species and habitats. On the other hand, DenseNet-201’s densely connected architecture enhances its adaptability to varying image quality, making it a robust choice for challenging field conditions. Our empirical experiments unveil the remarkable performance of both models under ideal circumstances. However, in demanding situations such as low-light conditions and adverse weather, DenseNet-201 consistently exhibits superior performance compared to RetinaNet-152.

articleTitle: Implementation of Artificial Intelligence and Line Optimization Algorithm based Multi-Level Inverter for Grid tied PV System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: In general, multilevel inverter plays a key role in present high and medium power operations. This research presents a Grid-connected PV system layout with multilayer inverters. To improve the performance of the PV system, a mathematical analysis is employed to build it, and an MPPT-based dc-dc boost converter is used. The distribution power system’s industrial loads are managed by non-sinusoidal and non-periodic current power electronics converters. Because the voltage/current wave shape is damaged, the real power flow from the distributed system to the load is reduced, which increases line losses. As a result, reactive power must be injected into the system from an external device in order to rectify the current waveform towards sinusoidal and so maximize the real power flow in the distribution system. This paper proposes the implementation of new 51-levelmultilevel inverter for grid tied PV system also help to control the active and reactive powers effected due to sudden changes in the system. A closed loop controller with grid and inverter currents is designed to control the powers. In this a comparative analysis is done between fuzzy controller and LOA optimization techniques.

Author Keywords: LOA optimization techniques and Fuzzy Controller

articleTitle: Integrated Machine Learning Paradigms with Simulation based Mathematical Modeling for Dengue Fever
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: This investigation explores the creation and examination of a thorough mathematical model for the dynamics of dengue disease transmission, which includes important epidemiological variables and the dynamics of vaccination. The study investigates the usefulness of the model in forecasting epidemics, evaluating immunization plans, and enhancing public health interventions. The answer entails a thorough examination of periodic orbits and fixed points to reveal probable chaotic behavior and attractors. The behavior of the model under different parameter values is investigated using bifurcation analysis, providing insights into important aspects affecting dengue dynamics. The study also discusses the model’s relevance in practical decision-making and highlights its usefulness in forecasting the dengue virus’s worldwide burden.

articleTitle: MIMO - OFDM System Performance Analysis with Systemvue
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: The Multiple Input-Multiple Output (MIMO) antenna technique has proven to meet the growing demand for applications in communication such as 3G, WLAN, and WiMAX, which require high data rates. Spatial correlation and antenna efficiency can partly describe the performance of MIMO systems. To realise an effective MIMO system, it is essential to have an adequate number of uncorrelated and highly efficient antennas at each end of the link. The software SystemVue is opted for signal processing and system-level simulation, with the merits of strong operability and high efficiency. This paper proposes a MIMO-OFDM system to achieve the high speed, high spectral efficiency, high capacity, and high reliability of modern communication systems. Reducing the channel fading caused by multipath propagation, thereby improving performance analyses such as BER, SNR, throughput,and channel capacity.

articleTitle: An Optimized Path Planning Technique in A Static Environment for Computer Vision Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization is a powerful and easy heuristic optimization technique that has proven effective in many complicated optimization situations. Its current application is in resolving the issue of mobile robot route planning. However, the PSO approach has numerous drawbacks, including a lengthy computation time, a sluggish rate of convergence, and a low likelihood of finding both local and global positions. As a result, path planning may require numerous rounds. In this work, we provide an advanced Particle Swarm Optimization (APSO) system based on a primary path planner that can effectively discover a virtual robot’s optimal path through static landscapes dotted with convex obstacles. The integration form of particle swarm optimization, accelerates convergence and produces more optimal outcomes with fewer iteration steps.

articleTitle: Vector Control of Vienna Rectifier for DC Fast Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: As the demand for electric vehicle (EV) fast charging grows, the role of efficient and grid-friendly power converters becomes crucial in ensuring reliable and high-performance charging systems. The paper presents a control method for an Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) fast charger utilizing a threephase Vienna rectifier (VR) for AC-DC power conversion. VR, increasingly popular in various industrial applications, including EV charging stations, high power density, great efficiency and offer small total harmonic distortion (THD). Through an inner current control loop, the suggested voltage-oriented control technique offers good steady-state performance and fast transient response. In order to effectively manage phase-to-phase coupling, the control structure, which features a dual closed-loop system with voltage as the outer loop and current as the inner loop, uses a feed-forward technique. Also, rectifier-induced voltage imbalances are corrected via the midpoint balance method and a voltage equalization loop. The system’s model is built, simulated, and validated using MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: A Review on Classification and Performance Analysis of Wideband Low Noise Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: For a variety of uses at various frequency bands, severlrst stages CG sa wireless communication standards have been created, including Bluetooth, LongTermEvolution (LTE), Digital-Enhanced Cordless Telecommunications (DECTs), Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi), and the GlobalSystem for MobileCommunications (GSM). Receivers that handle several standards on a single chip are attractive because they allow varied applications to be accommodated in a single device. One method of realizing those receivers is to integrate many narrowband front-ends together. LNAs are a unique kind of electronic amplifier and the first active building block that are employed in communication systems to amplify extremely weak signals that are picked up by a receiver antenna. The received-signal is usually amplified by an LNA after being filtered by BPF. It is an essential part of the receiver since its parameters, including its gain, bandwidth, and noise Fig (NF), have an immediate impact on the data rate, dynamic range, and sensitivity of the system. The source degeneration LNA has appealing features like decent gain, low NF, and good input matching. The intended frequency range determines which transistor (MOS) the LNA should use. A well-designed DC bias strategy seeks to pinpoint the optimal quiescent point. While an active bias network is often preferred for addressing small to moderate temperature fluctuations, a resistor bias network can also yield satisfactory outcomes.Several approaches to wideband design include common gate stages, distributed amplifiers, and traditional LNA noise cancellation. Another workable approach to wideband LNA design is the resistive shunt feedback architecture, which combines feed-forward and feedback approaches. This makes an inductor-less LNA an appealing option

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Wheeled Fire Fighting Robot with A Fire Extinguishing, Ball-Shooting Turret for Forest Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: An innovative wheeled fire extinguisher robot was born out of this endeavour. There are two degrees of freedom (DoF) in the defibrillator gun turret that the robot is equipped with. Using PID and SMC controls, robots can have their firing system mechanical oscillations regulated, which can be bothersome. The robot can move quickly on level ground because of its five-piece transformable wheel structure. On uneven terrain, the robot may climb obstacles by latching onto them thanks to the mechanism that opens the wheel, which transforms it into a star shape. Using Matlab’s Simmechanic environment, the fireman robot’s mechanical design was initially created in three dimensions. Creating a three-dimensional Simscape model and kinematic model of the turret system were the following steps. This model was used to mimic the throwing of fire-extinguishing balls onto fire spots placed 20 to 80 metres horizontally and 1 to 30 meters vertically under three different conditions: robot remains stationary, moves at constant speed, and rotates around itself. Out of 105 shots, the simulations yielded an $85.71 \%$ success rate with PID and a $\mathbf{9 5. 2 3 \%}$ success rate with SMC. The built fire robot was shown to be useful in firefighting after the error rates were examined.

articleTitle: A Review on Student Performance Prediction Based on Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Educational Organizations have lots of student-related data. This may be beneficial for predicting student-related activities. Mining such academic-related data will be helpful for academic organizations to comprehend the performance of various stakeholders. Educational Data Mining, is a prominent area that explores various frameworks and approaches to handle data related to education. Predicting student performance is one crucial aspect where EDM can play a significant role. This paper presents data collected from popular data sources through the review of relevant papers. This review primarily focuses on three major areas Machine Learning Techniques, Student Attributes, and Feature Selection Techniques. The study explores factors relevant to Student Success Prediction and assesses the effectiveness of different machine learning techniques applied to enhance predictive models for student success.

articleTitle: Automated Hypertensive Retinopathy Detection Method Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-This research describes a technique for identifying Maculopathy and Hypertensive Retinopathy (HR) using fundus retinal images, which are images of the rear of the eye. These illnesses have the potential to create long-term vision issues if they are not treated promptly. Maculopathy and HR are prevalent and significant retinal disorders. Heart rate (HR), which is frequently associated with excessive blood pressure, may not always be evident and may even cause cardiac issues. When not detected in a timely manner, HR, along with Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), is a major cause of eye problems. Here, the necessity of prompt diagnosis and appropriate treatment for conditions affecting the retina-the sensitive area in the back of the eye-is highlighted. Enabling prompt safety measures and appropriate diagnosis. This is significant since these illnesses have the potential to subtly impair eyesight and, in the case of HR, the heart as well. The paper’s goal is to help avert serious outcomes by identifying and treating these retinal illnesses at an early stage through the proposal of a detection method. To put it simply, the study emphasizes the necessity for a trustworthy method for identifying various eye disorders from pictures so that medical professionals may take the appropriate precautions to preserve patients’ eyesight and general health.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Two-Port Antenna for Multi-Band Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: In this paper, the MIMO antenna with frequency reconfigurability is proposed. The proposed compact singlelayer MIMO antenna achieves frequency reconfigurability by altering the excitation of different ports, which are fed using microstrip lines. To enhance the antenna’s performance and bandwidth, a split ring resonator (SRR) is incorporated. The antenna’s dimensions of $35 \times 90 \times 0.8 \mathrm{~mm}^{3}$ make it ideal for compact applications. It offers a broad bandwidth of about 420 MHz, specifically targeting the ($3.9-5.9 \mathrm{GHz}$) frequency band. The antenna exhibits versatility, being usable at different frequencies within the ranges of $(4.63-5.1 \mathrm{GHz})$ and $(6-6.2 \mathrm{GHz})$, catering to various wideband applications. This design presents a promising solution for wireless communication systems requiring compact and frequency-agile antennas with enhanced performance characteristics. The proposed antenna achieves circular polarization.

articleTitle: Revealing Image Deepfakes: A Convolutional Neural Network Approach Leveraging VGG-16 Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Digital image forgery has become a prevalent issue in modern technology-driven sphere, where sophisticated editing tools allow malicious users to create misleading and deceptive visual content. To deal with this growing problem, deep learning techniques have emerged as a powerful tool for both preventing and detecting digital image manipulation. In the proposed project focussing on developing deep learningbased forgery detection methods that can accurately identify manipulated images and to localize the forged part in the image using different methodologies, including VGG-16 which is a standard deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN),U-net, to build robust detection models capable of detecting a wide range of forgery techniques. Evaluating the effectiveness of our proposed forgery detection model, then building a comprehensive dataset consisting of authentic and forged images with diverse manipulation techniques. Furthermore, the proposed project addresses the challenge of detecting forged images that are altered to bypass existing detection mechanisms.

articleTitle: Real-Time Accident Detection and Reporting Using the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Accidents are seen as among the most harmful events. Although many different factors might cause an automobile collision, driver negligence and excessive speed are the most common causes. Additionally, it appears that a lack of awareness makes it difficult to arrive at the scene of the collision in time. The emergence of Internet of Things (IoT) technology can help solve this problem by lowering the incidence of accidents. The explanation of a clever system that warns drivers regulates vehicle speed, and notifies others appropriately in the case of an accident. This gadget continually monitors the distance between any obstructions and approaching cars using a distance sensor. It will automatically slow down and advise the driver to control speed as a crucial distance approaches. If an accident happens under suspicious conditions, the accountable party will get a warning message with information about the involved car. The primary objective of accident prevention is to decrease the number of traffic collisions that result in the loss of human life and other valuable goods. The Accident Prevention and Detection System (APDS) prevents fatalities by shortening the response time of emergency personnel. We are creating an Internet of Things application that will lower the accident rate.

articleTitle: AGRIFOG: Fog-Assisted IOT Enabled Agriculture Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: In response to the evolving landscape of agriculture, this report introduces a Fog-enabled IoT agriculture monitoring system aimed at transforming precision farming. The system’s architecture integrates an ESP32 microcontroller interfacing with soil moisture and DHT11 sensors, establishing a resilient network for real-time data acquisition and transmission. Leveraging MQTT communication protocols, the ESP32 seamlessly interacts with a Raspberry Pi Fog node, enabling local real-time analysis and control actions. The integration with the Google Drive API ensures secure cloud storage and periodic synchronization, facilitating historical analysis and visualization. The system’s scalability and affordability are demonstrated through ESP32 firmware development using the Arduino IDE, presenting a practical solution for widespread adoption. The assessment of the system’s performance involved evaluating latency and traffic metrics. With a recorded latency of 0.393 milliseconds, the system exhibits remarkable responsiveness to requests, ensuring efficient interactions with the Google Drive API. Simultaneously, the traffic rate of 0.131 requests per second indicates a moderate level of activity between the application and the cloud platform, underscoring the system’s efficiency in handling data interactions. This Fog-enabled IoT agriculture monitoring system addresses inherent flaws in traditional IoT applications. By incorporating Fog computing, the system overcomes latency challenges, ensuring real-time responsiveness crucial for precision farming. Field tests have substantiated the system’s efficacy in providing timely and reliable data for informed decision-making in agricultural practices. Future directions for system enhancement include the incorporation of advanced machine learning techniques and additional sensors such as $\mathbf{p H}$, light intensity, NPK, and airflow sensors. Thes additions aim to broaden the range of monitored parameters offering nuanced insights for precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Augmented Insights: A Qualified Evaluation of Deep Learning Representations for Enhancing Banana Leaf Spot Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: The manufacturing of bananas is tough due to a wide variety of diseases that reduce crop yields extensively. This proposed research advances the sector of banana leaf spot disorder detection through a detailed qualifying or comparative evaluation of Deep gaining knowledge of Deep Learning (DL) representations. Examining the performance of important methods consisting of ResNet, VGG19, and EfficientNetB0 in diagnosing banana leaf spot diseases. With picture photograph or image augmentation as an essential step, the studies conduct a comprehensive assessment among unique original and augmented pics, clarifying their impact on version performance. The proposed work reports accuracy rates for authentic photos as $78.82\%$ for ResNet, $77.65 \%$ for VGG19, and a surprising $85.88 \%$ for EfficientNetB0. For augmented photographs ResNet showed a $90.24 \%$ accuracy rate, VGG19 $74.74 \%$, and EfficientNetB0 $94.43 \%$. Because of this dual assessment approach, EfficientNetB0 is found to be powerful in identifying banana leaf diseases as well as highlighting the vital function photograph augmentation performs. The reason for this work is to offer precious insight into the comparative performance of banana farming strategies via the incorporation of pioneering technology. This research lays specific significance on the augmentation of image databases, highlighting its significance in attaining improved accuracy. Through a dual approach, model robustness is highly improved throughout multiple datasets, giving us a normal angle on how they carry out below real-world conditions.

articleTitle: Simulation of V2G to Home Power Interface using ANN Voltage Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: The integration of Electric Vehicles (EVs) into the electrical grid poses a number of challenges and opportunities for the effective use of renewable energy sources and load management. In a wireless vehicle-to-grid (V2G) to home power interface, the primary focus of this research is a novel voltage control technique based on artificial neural networks (ANNs). Through the utilization of bidirectional power flow among EVs, the grid, and residential dwellings, the suggested system maximizes energy exchange while upholding grid stability and home power cleanliness. A directional power flow interface is primarily required for Electric Vehicles (EVs) to use the Vehicle to Grid (V2G) concept to supply grid services. The proposed wireless vehicle-grid-home power interface (WVGH-PI) enhances power quality by accounting for the harmonic and reactive power of nonlinear household loads. In order to enable two-way energy flow, the grid side low frequency to DC converter is typically limited to use in wireless bidirectional chargers. Furthermore, an Artificial Neural Network Controller is proposed to improve the overall effectiveness of the interface. To evaluate the functionality of the proposed wireless interface, a variety of modes and dynamic scenarios are looked at. To substantiate the validity of the proposed concept, simulations and experiments from a 1 kW prototype are presented along with comparisons to conventional control.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Coal Mine Safety Monitoring and Alerting System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Safety is the most vital part of any type of industry. In the mining industry safety and security is a fundamental aspect for all. To avoid any types of accidents the mining industry takes some basic precautions. Still accidents take place in underground mines due to rise in temperature, increased water level, and many toxic gases leakage, fire accidents, and so on must be monitored regularly. The safe production level of coal mines is still low, disasters in coal mine occur frequently, which lead to great loss of possession and life. The disasters happening in coal mines are due to the complexity of the mine environment and the variety of work carried out in coal mines, so it is very necessary to monitor the working environment of coal mine. To get over this problem, we proposed an alert system for the people who are working in mines. In this project we have to parts one is transmitter section and the other one is receiver section. The transmission section will be present at the workers end and receiver section will be at officials end. Through this alert system messages will be sent to the officials to act, and the workers also get alerted by red LED glow and a buzzer will be horn and through the LCD display. This monitoring and alerting system is powered by an Atmega328 microcontroller and NodeMCU ESP8266 microcontroller. We are using MQ2 sensor, DHT11 sensor, RF transmitter and receivers to detect the temperature, humidity and many toxic gases leakage and alert the workers and other officials to evacuate from that dangerous place.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition with CNN in FastAI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Human activity recognition (HAR) is the designated term for the automated distinguishing of physical activities conducted by individuals. The current study analyzes convolutional neural networks (CNN) in human activity recognition, particularly on datasets including images. By analyzing and correctly identifying the activities performed by individuals in image datasets, analysts and programmers can achieve a valuable understanding of human behaviors across different circumstances. HAR involves the automation of detection and categorization of activities that are performed by individuals and are included in image datasets using deep learning methodologies and advanced image processing techniques. Here, we propose a deep learning methodology that can accurately classify the given input images into various activities like sitting, standing, walking, and sleeping. To determine the model’s efficiency, we have employed a comprehensive dataset that is available in Kaggle’s repository, namely the activity dataset. This dataset offers a wide range of authentic and varied activities performed by groups of individuals across different locations. It contains an array of labeled images capturing their activities, like sitting, standing, walking, and sleeping, across diverse circumstances. This research established an unusual approach for HAR, which was empowered by CNN Drive by FastAI and offered an easy and accessible deep learning platform for users.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of Digitalisation in the Tourism & Hospitality Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Digitalisation in every sector has increased rapidly after the COVID-19 pandemic, and the tourism & hospitality industry needs to catch up. Social distancing and tourist safety were prime concerns, forcing the industry to switch to digitalisation. This study attempts to discover the publications, citation trends, and countries involved in digitalisation in tourism & hospitality (DT&H). Since 1956, 499 articles have been published, but only 485 articles have been extracted from the Scopus database after excluding the incomplete information. Most documents on DT&H were published in 2022; however, most citations were generated in 2021. VOSviewer was used for countries’ bibliographical coupling and keywords cooccurrence, and Biblioshiny (R-tool) was used to find trending topics and thematic evolution. The Russian Federation published the maximum number of articles, whereas the United Kingdom has had the maximum number of citations since its inception. India, France, Malaysia, Croatia, South Africa, and Australia are emerging countries in DT&H. Digitalisation and tourism are the highly occurring keywords. Tourism is the top trending keyword, followed by digitalisation and tourism management. Historical preservation, performance, heritage tourism, and personnel are emerging or declining themes. Future researchers can use the emerging theme for their work and explore the role of digitalisation in heritage tourism. Databases bigger than 500 metadata may help generalize the output and can be accepted readily.

articleTitle: A Review on Helmet Detection of Motorcyclists in Different Atmospheric Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Abstract-Due to the rising population in emerging nations, the number of traffic fatalities is rising nowadays. A complex program called an intelligent transport system (ITS) supports many types of transportation and traffic management. As part of the ITS services, roadside units help monitor traffic laws and emergency rescue calls. It has been noticed that failure to wear a helmet is a common cause of fata motorcycle accidents. Automatically identifying helmet infractions by motorcycle riders from real-time recordings is a difficult application for ITS. It enables the identification and punishment of bikers who are not wearing helmets Therefore, it is necessary to create a system that can instantly identify and detain motorcycle riders who are not wearing helmets. Using different types of deep learning techniques such as CNN, RCNN, Faster-RCNN, and YOLO. These techniques process film’s input and detect helmet violations. This study proposes to automatically detect helmet violations using surveillance footage from cameras placed alongthe side of the road. This suggested technique detects helmet violations and penalizes traffic law breakers using footage as input. The method YOLO-v8 described in this article use surveillance filmcaptured by cameras positioned along the side of the road in a variety of weather situations such as cloudy, clear, rainy, foggy, windy, stormy, and snowy. In order to prosecute those who violate traffic laws, will be punishes by thecourt of law.

articleTitle: Risk factors associated with cardiovascular disease: A Case-Control Study Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: cardiovascular disease (CVD) is a major global mortality problem because it requires complex investigations, diagnosis, and treatment strategies. Treating cardiovascular diseases is extremely important because of their high mortality and economic burden. Innovations in biomimetic modeling of heart tissue, wearable mHealth for screening, and the integration of hemodynamic modeling, medical imaging, and machine learning offer promising opportunities for improving cardiovascular disease research and patient care. A new 3-D model that simulates hemodynamic stresses is used to study heart cells under different conditions. There is a need for more accurate forecasting models. Improving the precision of the CTC model had better mimic complex hemodynamic stresses associated with heart pressure and volume changes. Improving hemodynamic modeling techniques to provide clinicians with more accurate before and after procedures for decision-making. Advanced CTC modeling accurately reproduces hemodynamic stresses, providing a valuable tool in cardiac cell studies. Wearable mHealth solutions effectively balance the management of acute cardiovascular disease and infection risks and improve patient outcomes. The framework shows superior accuracy in the early prediction of CVD, outperforming current methods. Heart disease is a major cause of death around the world, and it’s important to figure out how to treat it.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on IPv6 Over Low Power Wireless Personal Area Networks (6LoWPAN)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to a network of physical objects embedded with sensors, software, and networking capabilities, enabling them to collect and exchange data over the internet. Within IoT applications, Low Power Wireless Personal Area Networks (LP-WPANs) hold significant importance. One of the primary challenges in IoT implementation involves connecting devices that possess low power and limited resources. To overcome this challenge, the IPv6 Over Low Power Wireless Personal Area Networks (6LoWPAN) protocol stack was developed. Within 6LoWPAN networks, congestion arising from excessive network traffic leads to a notable decline in network performance and negatively impacts Quality of Service (QoS). This paper presents the 6LoWPAN network, specifically designed to facilitate the transmission of IPv6 packets over IEEE 802.15.4 wireless networks. It outlines the components of the 6LoWPAN protocol stack, including the adaptation layer, network layer, and transport layer. Additionally, the paper explores congestion within 6LoWPAN networks and discusses various congestion control algorithms proposed to mitigate this issue. The paper explores the applications of GLoWPAN, focusing on its potential in the IoT ecosystem. It highlights the benefits of 6LoWPAN for IoT applications, including its ability to support large numbers of low-power devices and compatibility with existing IPv6-based systems. Finally, the paper discusses security issues in 6LoWPAN.

Author Keywords: Low power and Personal Area Networks

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Feature Ranking Algorithms for Erythemato-Squamous Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Erythemato-Squamous Diseases (ESD) are a group of skin disorders characterized by erythema (redness) and scaling. These conditions include, among others, psoriasis, seborrheic dermatitis, lichen planus, pityriasis rosea, Chronic Dermatitis, and Pityriasis rubra pilaris. Diverse classification systems have been proposed in the past to aid in the identification and management of ESDs. Traditional classification systems divide ESD into two primary categories: erythematous and squamous. They are able to distinguish between non-infectious and infectious ESDs based on the presence or absence of a fungal infection but are unable to categorize the specific type of ESD. This paper presents machine learning (ML) algorithms and state-of-the-art feature ranking algorithms for analyzing clinical data, such as patient symptoms, medical history, and visual representations of skin lesions, in order to aid in the classification and diagnosis of ESDs. The study uses state-of-the-art feature ranking algorithms such as minimum redundancy maximum relevance (MRMR), analysis of variance (ANOVA), and Kruskal-Wallis to determine the most effective features for classifying ESDs. The efficacy of ML classifiers is evaluated using a various set of best features that are identified by feature ranking algorithms. Additionally, the performance analysis is also done with different training rates. According to the analysis, Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Ensemble classifiers obtain better performance than other ML classifiers.

articleTitle: An Advanced Integration Strategy for a DSWIG BasedWES and DSPVS in a Typical Microgrid Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Dual stator winding induction generator (DSWIG) based wind energy system (WES) and distributed solar photovoltaic system (DSPVS) are the typical renewable selections for the distant microgrid application in most cases. DSWIG is undoubtedly a superior choice for the wind energy conversion as it allows to control the voltage and frequency more substantially, even in the absence of power electronic interfaces. Energy derived from the solar is exceptional and whereas the remarkable confines are stated in the research especially for the standalone networks. Essentially, the reliability of the power networks certainly lies in the renewable integration via microgrid structures. The periodic breaks witnessed in this intermittent sources are streamlined vitally through the integration strategy which may results in the stabilized and regulated power outputs. Hence this research justifies the discussion by practicing the novel method of integrating the renewable sources based on the appropriate choice of the system design and control elements. Results are simulated via PSCAD/EMTDC platform to validate.

articleTitle: Cognitive Grasp: A Robotic Arm Responding to Human Muscle Intent
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Social and Sustainable Innovations in Technology and Engineering (SASI-ITE)
abstract: Examining the combination of the STM-32 Nucleo 144 board, 5G technology, and Electromyography (EMG) sensors to handle major difficulties in medical robotic arms, this proposed research addresses precision, adaptability, and gentle holding moments during surgical procedures and patient care.
